d.ko: Business is booming for La Soleil, the patisserie run by Kashou Minaduki with his two catgirls, Chocola and Vanilla, his sister Shigure, and the Minaduki family's four catgirl sisters.
d.en: Business is booming for La Soleil, the patisserie run by Kashou Minaduki with his two catgirls, Chocola and Vanilla, his sister Shigure, and the Minaduki family's four catgirl sisters.
d.zh:
由水無月嘉祥經營的蛋糕店「Soleil」，今天也在水無月家貓娘四姊妹＋妹妹時雨的幫忙下努力營業著。
嘴巴壞又不坦率，但實際上十項全能又愛護妹妹的長女紅豆，
以及正直又努力，可是卻笨手笨腳又愛逞強的四女椰子，
過去在姊妹中感情最好的這兩隻貓娘，不知何時開始變成了一對成天吵不膩的歡喜冤家。

rv.t: 젠장 아즈키 난 네가 좋다! 네코파라 시리즈의 2번째 이야기 거스를 움켜잡으며 수없이 감탄했다 내가 여태까지 해 왔던 야겜들은 다 무엇이란 말인가? …

Still no gameplay just me clicking, reading, and wondering how this series keeps making doing absolutely nothing feel so relaxing. This time it focuses on the new pair and yeah I’m invested. Again I did not learn my lesson. …

The 2nd installment in the series focuses on Azuki and Coconut. The story keeps up the usual vibe, nothin flashy, just warm and heartwarmin. The live2d qualitys still solid, Vol.3 is already lined up to play.
Another goofy hentai game with all the hentai censored out. Rated thumbs down for censorship.
